# goslop text fixture — sole ValueError after pure index probe (kiss_headers)
lang: python
file: utils.py
---
def header_strip(content: str, elem: str) -> str:
    next_semi_colon_index = None
    elem_end_index = content.index(elem) + len(elem)
    try:
        next_semi_colon_index = elem_end_index + content[elem_end_index:].index(";")
    except ValueError:
        pass
    return content
